description: This repository records appointment waiting times for veterans receiving primary and specialty care in Veterans Health Administration facilities and community medical centres. VA Boston Healthcare System research collaborators publish deidentified referral-level records and geographic or facility summaries, with SQL preparation code and selected R analyses. Current version 16 describes approximately fifty-two million waits from January 2014 through December 2022, extending the original article’s earlier thirty-eight-million-record description. Mendeley provides CSV, SQL, R and supporting XLSX/PDF files free under CC BY 4.0. Individual CSV files can exceed four gigabytes. Coverage concerns veterans’ referral pathways, not the whole US population; referral, facility, county and ZIP summaries are different analytical units. These limitations matter for service-access comparisons. Modellers could calibrate appointment-delay distributions or explore capacity scenarios. model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a related simulation pattern, while data-ahrq-hcup-hospital-utilization-databases covers inpatient utilisation. Only public metadata were read; no referral or patient-level file was downloaded.
